description: This file is a PHP source code file defining the CustomerGroup model class within the Opencart catalog module. It includes methods for retrieving customer group data from the database.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: A model class responsible for accessing customer group data, including methods to retrieve individual customer group details and list of customer groups from the database.

methods.name: getCustomerGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific customer group by its ID, returning an associative array containing customer group information.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all customer groups, returning an array of customer group records.
